concerns.text: SC-001 states “Task success rate on complex, multi-hop tasks is measured against the baseline success rate to quantify performance degradation.” It describes what will be measured but provides no quantitative target, acceptance threshold, or decision rule, making it impossible to determine whether the criterion is met.

SC-002 says “Efficiency penalty (agent calls / optimal calls) is measured against the theoretical minimum valid sequence length (tool diversity count) to identify redundant strategies.” Like SC-001, it lacks a concrete success threshold (e.g., a maximum acceptable penalty or a required reduction), so the outcome cannot be judged as passed or failed.
